verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government is not offering a free 3-month mobile recharge. Messages promoting this are a scam intended to steal personal information or commit financial fraud.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Numerous fact-checking organizations and the Indian government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) have repeatedly debunked this claim. The evidence consistently shows that no such government scheme exists. These viral messages are identified as scams that use fraudulent links to trick users, potentially leading to data theft. The claim has appeared in various forms over several years, often using edited or AI-generated videos of the Prime Minister, but is consistently proven to be fraudulent.
